The default V1 backend (`AgentLoopManagerTQ`) decouples rollout submission from collection via a fire-and-forget TransferQueue: outputs are collected **in completion order**, which depends on per-request latency and varies across runs, so the output concatenation order (and thus the training batch) differs run-to-run. The default V1 backend (`AgentLoopManagerTQ`) decouples rollout submission from collection via a fire-and-forget TransferQueue: outputs are collected **in completion order**, which depends on per-request latency and varies across runs, so the output concatenation order (and thus the training batch) differs run-to-run.
